parsed.reason: This message fails on multiple critical counts. It names a technical cause ("technical error") that Hale cannot know, violates the core instruction by handing the parent an errand ("please check the app" and "try again in 5 minutes"), includes incident/support-desk language ("technical error"), contains an emoji (which is explicitly forbidden), and—most importantly per watchFor—provides a link and app pointer when the failure was on Hale's end. The parent should not be sent anywhere to check or retry; they should hear that nothing changed on Hale's side in plain, direct language. This reads like corporate support language, not a competent friend owning a mistake.
